content: Asi Ba Haaro Naagiza Woga
«Issi asi boora woykko dorsa kaysoti ekkidi shukkiko, woykko bayzi ekkiko, issi boora gishshas ichchashu boora, issi dorsa gishshas oyddu dors qanxxo.
«Kaysoy keeth bookkishe oykettidi shocetti hayqqiko shocidayssi suuth gussida gishshas oychchettenna.

Gido attiin hessi gadey wonti geyiin hanizaa gidikko izi he gukkida suuththaa acon oyshettees. Kaysozi kaysotidayssa qanxxo; gido attiin izas aykkoyka bayndaa gidikko kaysotidayssa qanxxanaas izi bayzetto.
Izi kaysotida mehey paxa dishe iza kushen beettiko, boora woykko hare woykko dorsa gidikkoka izi ba kaysotidayssas nam7u kushe qanxxo.

«Issi asi ba mehe demban woykko ayfey meetettiza miththa giddon heemmishe, meheta hara asa kaththan la7a yeddi heemmiko, izi ba kaththaafe woykko ayfey meetettiza ba miththa ubbaafe lo7izayssa afilaama qanxxo.
«Issi asi buuraa xuuggiko tamay dendidi buuraza wursidi dooren diza kath woykko eqon diza kaththaa mulera mizaa gidikko koyro tama oyththida addezi afilaama qanxxo.
«Issi asi bira woykko hara miish naagissanaas ba shooros hadara immiko, shoorozasoppe he miishshaa kaysotida kaysozi oykettiko, kaysozi he miishshas nam7u kushe qanxxo.
Gido attiin kaysozi beettontta ixxiko, hadara ekkida addezi pirdizaytakko shiiqidi hadara miishsha izi miishshaa monttayssas caaqqo.

«Asi ay mootonkka boora geedon, woykko hare geedon, woykko dorsa geedon, woykko may7o geedon, woykko hara dhayda miishsha geedon, ‹Hayssi tayssa› giidi mootettiko, nam7u baggayka ba yo7oza pirdizayta sinth aaththetto; pirdizayti wordosida asi hankkoyssas nam7u kushe qanxxo.
«Asi ba shooros hare, woykko boora, woykko dorsa, woykko hara ay mehekka hadara immiin oonikka be7ontta hayqqiko, woykko qohettiko, woykko asi bonqqi efikko,
hadaraaddey ba shooro meheza bochchonttayssas GODAA sinththan caaqqiko, istta giddon diza yo7ozi wurees. He meheza goday caaqoza ekko; qanxxisanaas bessenna.
Gido attiin mehezi hadaraaddefe kaysotettidaa gidikko mehaaddes qanxxo.
He meheza do7ay midaa gidikko, markka gidana mala do7ay mishin attidayssafe ekki ehi besso; histtidi meetettida meheza gishshas qanxxofo.
«Asi ba shooroppe mehe garxxi ekkiko iza goday bayndason he mehey qohettiko woykko hayqqiko he meheza gishshas qanxxo.
Gido attiin iza goday izara diikko, garxxidayssi qanxxofo; kiras ekkidaa gidikko kiras ciggiza miishshay acozas qanxxo gido.
Geeshsha De7onne Ammano Woga
«Issi asi azinas giigontta geela7oyo baleththidi izira zin7izaa gidikko izo cilooshidi baas machcho ekko.
Izi aaway izo izas immontta ixxiko, geela7oyo ekkiza asi cilooshas imettiza miishshaa keena bira izi aawaas immo.
«Bita bitiza maccas paxa woththofa.
«Mehera gaaggiza asi oonikka hayqqo.
«GODAAS xalalappe attiin hara xoossas shukki yarshiza asi oonikka hayqqi dhayo.
«Betidi yida as qohopite, woykko waayisopite; gaasoykka intteka Gibxe biittan bete gididi de7ideta.
Azinay hayqqida am7eyonne aaway woykko aaya hayqqida naa waayisopite.
Intte istta waayisiin istti taakko waassiko tani istta waaso tumappe siyana;
he wode ta hanqoy intte bolla dendana; tani inttena mashshan wursana; intte machcheti am7eta intte naytikka aaway baynda yi7o nayta gidana.
«Intte giddon diza ta asaas issi manqo asas miishshe tal7iko, ba miish dichchas immiza asa mala hanopite; neni yelo iza oychchofa.
Neni issi miishsha gishshas ne lagge may7o oykkiko arshey wullontta dishin izas zaara.
Aazas giikko izi ba kallo kammizay izin xalla; hara ay may7idi aqanaas dandayzee? Izi taas waassiko ta mishettiza gishshas izas siyananne iza maaddana.
«Xoossa bolla cashsha qaala haasayoppa, woykko dere ayssizaade qanggofa.
«Ne kaththa xeera, woyne miththa ayfe xeeranne wogara
zayte taas yarsho shiishsha. Neni ne attuma nayta giddon bayratiza naa taas immanaas bessees.
Boorappe, deyshafenne dorsafekka hessaththo ooththa. Istti laappun gallassay gakkanaas, ba aayira aayira gam7etto; osppunththa gallas istta taas imma.
«Intte taas geeshsha as gidanaas koshshees; hessa gishshas do7ay demban wodhida woykko dafi daakkida mehe asho kanas yeggite attiin moopite.

footnotes.text: Wogara: Wogara gizayssa issi issi bagga Gamoththo qaalan woyra woykko shamaho woykko gultta geettes.
